lead.headline: First place is up 7 and still the underdog
lead.dek: AB81 banked 22.58 on Thursday, 17.0 of it from its kicker. Cherry Blossom still projects to win by 13. The leader has one move left, and the clock runs out at Sun 10:00 AM.
body: I’ve covered AB81 all season, and nothing about this team has ever made sense on paper. It’s 7-1. Its all-play record is 28-28. It’s the luckiest team in the league at plus 3.0 wins. And this morning it walks into Sunday leading Cherry Blossom 22.58 to 15.58 while every model in the building says it loses. Cherry Blossom projects 164.83 to 151.8. AB81 wins 36.8% of the time.

Look at how AB81 got here. Cam Little, a kicker projected for 6.53, put up 17.0 on Thursday. Derrick Henry added 5.58. That’s the lead. Cherry Blossom answered with 13.58 from Trevor Lawrence and 2.0 from its Baltimore defense, and has nine starters left: Jared Goff, Christian McCaffrey, Jonah Coleman, Tee Higgins, Puka Nacua, Travis Kelce, Brock Bowers, Jameson Williams and Jake Bates. Nacua alone projects 23.42. McCaffrey is 22.61.

Now the decision. George Kittle is on the AB81 bench at 15.68, and the starting lineup has Makai Lemon at receiver for 7.98. The fix is a three-piece shuffle: Kittle in at tight end, Dallas Goedert slides to flex, Darius Cooper moves to receiver, Lemon sits. It’s worth 7.70, and it takes the AB81 lineup from 139.98 to 147.68. Sleeper lists the deadline as Sun 1:05 PM, Kittle’s kickoff. That’s not the real clock. Lemon, Goedert and Cooper all play Sun 10:00 AM, and once they lock, the shuffle is gone. I’d make it with coffee.

The other thing to watch is under center. With Sam Darnold Out and Jalen Hurts on IR, AB81 is starting Joe Milton at 12.58 next to Matthew Stafford at 18.38. The bench has no healthy quarterback, so that’s the pair, and Milton is the soft spot. Mike Evans and DeVonta Smith are Out too. This roster is held together with tape and a kicker.

Here’s my call: Cherry Blossom. It’s 4-4, at 99.5% to make the playoffs, and its lineup is close to clean: 173.34 as set, 174.14 at its best. AB81 makes the shuffle, gets a monster day from Jaxon Smith-Njigba at 24.07, and still needs Cherry Blossom’s stars to show up small. It has done stranger things. That’s the whole point of AB81.

quick_hits.headline: deeboliciouskins cleared its board overnight
quick_hits.body: Patrick Mahomes is in at quarterback for Kyler Murray, now Out. Tyler Warren at 13.31 took the tight end job from T.J. Hockenson, and Malik Nabers at 15.7 fills the flex hole Tony Pollard’s bye left. deeboliciouskins now projects 162.65 as set and wins 87.8% of the time. The only call left is George Pickens.

quick_hits.headline: St. Brown’s ribs swing a whole matchup
quick_hits.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown is Questionable with ribs and projects 20.19. Jaylen Waddle is 11.06 and clean, so the gap is nine points. Maye I touch your TDs? is 32.2% to beat Poochinski, and that number assumes St. Brown plays. Check the inactives before Sun 10:00 AM. If he’s up, he starts.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski’s Olave call goes to the wire
quick_hits.body: Chris Olave at 15.35 over Chris Godwin Jr. at 9.35 is 6.0 points, and it turns 171.73 into 177.73. Poochinski is 67.8% either way. Olave’s game is Sun 10:00 AM, so this is the last morning the call is on the board.

quick_hits.headline: Six R.A.T.S. teams play before breakfast
quick_hits.body: The early game kicks at 6:30 AM Pacific and carries Bijan Robinson and Evan McPherson for Bad things, Ja’Marr Chase for deeboliciouskins, Joe Burrow and the Atlanta defense for the Finest, Chase Brown for Poochinski, Tee Higgins for Cherry Blossom and Drake London for Maye I touch your TDs?. Only Big Stric and AB81 can sleep in.

quick_hits.headline: The Finest plays this one with a 0.0 at QB
quick_hits.body: Lamar Jackson’s zero is locked, and Santa Clara’s Finest is 12.2% to beat deeboliciouskins. It did make its call at receiver: Denzel Boston in for Garrett Wilson. The bigger upgrade is still out there. Blake Corum is in the flex at 7.2, and Devin Singletary, the most-added player in Sleeper this morning, projects 14.29 and is on the wire.

w9-m1.headline: Bad things gets Sunday. Big Stric gets Monday.
w9-m1.blurb: 164.1 to 158.62, a 5.48-point gap. Bad things’ lineup is set and has no upside left to unlock. Big Stric has 11.0 banked and Josh Allen and Justin Jefferson waiting for Monday. Bad things, 55.3%, but I’ll be watching Monday night.

w9-m2.headline: deeboliciouskins did its homework
w9-m2.blurb: 164.28 to 116.93 on the live projection. The Finest needs a huge Burrow day and a Kenneth Walker III explosion, at 21.96 projected, just to make it a game. deeboliciouskins, 87.8%.

w9-m3.headline: St. Brown’s ribs are the upset case
w9-m3.blurb: Poochinski projects 177.73 to 158.88 if it starts Olave. Maye I touch your TDs? has 5.3 banked from Zay Flowers and needs St. Brown, Brock Purdy and Drake Maye all to hit. Poochinski, 67.8%.

w9-m4.headline: AB81 leads. Cherry Blossom is the pick.
w9-m4.blurb: 22.58 to 15.58 now, 164.83 to 151.8 projected. AB81 needs the Kittle shuffle before Sun 10:00 AM and a big Jaxon Smith-Njigba day. Cherry Blossom, 63.2%.

w9-r8-s5.headline: AB81’s Kittle shuffle: the real clock is 10:00 AM
w9-r8-s5.blurb: Kittle in at tight end, Goedert to flex, Cooper to receiver, Lemon out. That’s 15.68 over 7.98, a 7.70-point upgrade in a game AB81 trails on paper. Lemon, Goedert and Cooper kick at Sun 10:00 AM, so the listed Sun 1:05 PM is too late.

w9-r3-s4.headline: What will Maye I touch your TDs? do at WR?
w9-r3-s4.blurb: St. Brown at 20.19, Questionable with ribs, or Waddle at 11.06. If St. Brown is active, start him and don’t think twice. If he’s out, Waddle goes in before Sun 10:00 AM.

w9-r2-s4.headline: Olave or Godwin, final answer
w9-r2-s4.blurb: Olave, 15.35. Godwin, 9.35. Olave locks at Sun 10:00 AM. I’d put him in.

w9-r6-s4.headline: Pickens or DJ Moore? Watch the inactives.
w9-r6-s4.blurb: Pickens is Questionable with a hamstring at 13.54. DJ Moore is 12.78 and plays Mon 5:15 PM. Moore is the insurance policy, but the decision has to be made before Pickens’ Sun 10:00 AM kickoff, not Monday.

w9-r7-s6.headline: Henry or Loveland: the clock is 1:25 PM
w9-r7-s6.blurb: Colston Loveland, healthy at 10.84, over Hunter Henry, Questionable with a foot at 7.62. Henry’s game kicks at 1:25 PM Pacific, so that’s the deadline, not Loveland’s Sun 5:20 PM.

w9-r6-s0.headline: deeboliciouskins made its call at QB: Mahomes
w9-r6-s0.blurb: Kyler Murray, now Out, is on the bench. Patrick Mahomes is in at 21.24. Case closed.

w9-r7-s4.headline: The Finest made its call at WR: Boston in
w9-r7-s4.blurb: Garrett Wilson is Out with a concussion. Denzel Boston, 10.72, takes his spot. The safe call. The 13.48 Omar Cooper Jr. on the wire would have been the bolder one.

alert_notes.7: Lamar Jackson started at quarterback and his team played without him on Thursday. That 0.0 is locked for Week 9.

trending_notes.6130: The most-added player in Sleeper, at 14.29 projected, and unowned in R.A.T.S. The Finest’s flex has Blake Corum at 7.2. That’s the obvious landing spot.
trending_notes.13276: Unowned, 13.48 projected, and his game kicks at Sun 10:00 AM. Another live option for a Finest lineup that needs points anywhere it can find them.
trending_notes.13150: AB81’s Darius Cooper is trending up, and he’s in the AB81 flex at 8.74. If the Kittle shuffle happens, he slides to receiver.
trending_notes.8161: Bad things’ second quarterback, starting at 17.57 and trending up league-wide. His game is Sun 10:00 AM against a Detroit offense that three R.A.T.S. teams are leaning on, from Jahmyr Gibbs to Jared Goff to Amon-Ra St. Brown.

external_facts.claim: Cincinnati at Atlanta (Madrid) kicks off Sun 6:30 AM Pacific; Green Bay at New England kicks off Sun 1:25 PM Pacific.
